limitations: These are synthetic compilation samples, not a review of live collection, end-to-end routing, provider activation, or actual-news accuracy.

The fixture outputs show response payloads. validate_compilation additionally checks fields, citations, claims, and anchors against a SourceRevision; cleans the body and claim text; adds claim IDs, source revision IDs, and draft knowledge state; and may inject provenance-specific limitations. Those normalized results are not shown in the fixtures.
The validator's community and OCR limitation injections depend on the SourceRevision provenance class, which is not established by the compilation samples alone.
